name: Gakushin Bunken
source: A member of City's Guard and one of Gi's generals. Along with [url=/c25771]Maou[/url] and [url=/c25773]Sawa[/url], she's [url=/c63854]Kazuto's[/url] subordinate. Differently from Maou and Sawa, she's very serious about her duties and gets really mad when they skip on the job, but just like them, deep in her heart, she's a maiden and quickly falls deeply in love for Kazuto.
